_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Bastion egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: Bastion
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Bastion is a multi-purpose Discord bot for moderation, automation and music. Installs a Bastion release and builds it on first start; it needs a MongoDB database.
startup: if [ -z "$BOT_TOKEN" ] || [ -z "$MONGO_URI" ]; then echo "Set the bot token and the MongoDB connection in the server's startup settings, then start it again."; exit 1; fi; h=$(cat .bastion-version package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat dist/.raptor-built 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing Bastion's packages and building it. This takes a few minutes."; npm ci --no-fund --no-audit && npm run build && echo "$h" > dist/.raptor-built || exit 1; fi; if [ "{{PUBLISH_COMMANDS}}" = 1 ]; then npm run --silent commands || echo "Publishing the slash commands failed: starting anyway."; fi; export BASTION_API_PORT={{SERVER_PORT}}; exec node .

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Bastion: fetches a Bastion release from its Git repository. The bot is
# built when the server first starts. settings.yaml, .env and anything else
# that isn't part of Bastion's code are kept.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
repo=https://github.com/TheBastionBot/Bastion

version="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$version" = latest ] || version="v${version#v}"
# gh-release says why when the release doesn't exist or GitHub can't be reached.
tag=$(gh-release tag TheBastionBot/Bastion "$version") || exit 1

git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server
if [ "$(cat .bastion-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ] && [ -d .git ]; then
    echo "Bastion $tag is already here."
else
    echo "Fetching Bastion $tag."
    [ -d .git ] || git init -q
    git fetch -q --depth 1 "$repo" "refs/tags/$tag:refs/tags/$tag"
    # Only Bastion's own files are replaced; settings.yaml is not one of them.
    git -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout -q -f "$tag"
    grep -qx .bastion-version .git/info/exclude 2>/dev/null || echo .bastion-version >> .git/info/exclude
    echo "$tag" > .bastion-version
fi

if [ ! -f settings.yaml ]; then
    cp settings.example.yaml settings.yaml
    echo "Wrote settings.yaml: set the bot owners and presences there."
fi
echo "Installed Bastion $tag. It is built the first time it starts."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Bastion release to install, such as 10.19.0, or latest.

variables.name: Bot token
variables.description: Your Discord bot's token, from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables.name: Owner ID
variables.description: The Discord user ID of the bot's owner, added to the owners in settings.yaml.

variables.name: MongoDB connection
variables.description: The MongoDB connection string, such as mongodb://user:password@host:27017/bastion.

variables.name: Publish commands at start
variables.description: Register Bastion's slash commands with Discord every time it starts.

variables.name: Music activity
variables.description: Show the track that's playing as the bot's activity.

variables.name: Relay direct messages
variables.description: Forward direct messages the bot gets to its owner.

variables.name: Unsafe mode
variables.description: Allow the owner-only exec and eval commands. Leave it off unless you alone own the bot.

variables.name: API password
variables.description: A password for Bastion's web API on the server's port. Leave it empty to turn the API off.
